data/recoil_decay.json._comment: Per-weapon ADS recoil decay tables from sym.gg. retain = exp(-decFactor * decOffset * interShotTime^decTimeExp) ^ decExp. Source of truth for index.html and preview_spread.html.

data/weapons.json.damageSource: In-game reading: NVO-228E tiers without the 75 m step; 20.67 is retained past 36 m. The datamined changelist 28877515 table lists a further 17.13 tier past 75 m that the weapon does not apply.

sourced.source: Battlefield Companion datamined weapon table (companionbattlefield.com bundle; "Local BF6 files; bf6-s4-changelist-28877515")

notes: emptyRld is null: the datamined table publishes a single reloadSec, which matches tacRld.
fireMode semi is confirmed in game; the Full Auto ergonomics card (40 pts, named "Folding Stock" on this weapon) converts it, same subtype as the M16 A3 Receiver.
Damage is the in-game curve, which drops the datamined 17.13 tier past 75 m.

rpm 450 is the in-game semi-auto rate. The datamined table lists 800, which the captures show is the Folding Stock full-auto rate; the sim has no per-attachment rate override, so the stock rate is stored.
Magazine, grip, ammo and ergonomics coverage is derived from the 2026-07-26 VSSM screenshot corpus; all 43 captures reproduce in the sim.

QD Grip Pod is bugged on this weapon only. It and Alloy Vertical are both tier 2 cards, and the 1.3.3.0 capture corpus shows them matching on BROD 3 (0.7), EF88 (0.6), M16A4 (0.6) and RPK-74M (0.4); on the VSSM Alloy reads 0.8 and QD reads 0.7, a tier 3 benefit at tier 2 cost. Changelist 28877515 lists tier 3 for all five, but it only manifests here, so the catalog keeps the tier 2 card.
